headline: Graphic Design Trainee
tagline: Graphic designer with agency experience creating social campaigns, digital assets, and AI-assisted workflows.

skills.label: Design Tools

skills.label: Core Competencies
skills.items: Social and marketing creative, branding and visual identity, typography, layout, print production, design systems

skills.label: Workflows
skills.items: AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly), wireframing, prototyping, usability testing

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives across employee engagement, branding, recruitment, and onboarding.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Managed print-ready file preparation including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.

Partnered with HR and management stakeholders to deliver marketing collateral with low revision cycles.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Conducted usability testing and fed findings back into user flows and interface usability.

Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Collaborated with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that resulted in a 15% increase in follower engagement.
Maintained consistency in brand visuals and content formats across digital platforms.

projects.name: Bounceless
